newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open higher on Wall Street euphoria.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open higher on Wall Street euphoria.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened higher on Wednesday, as participants bought blue-chip shares, in particular high-technology issues, after the Dow industrial's surge to an all-time high overnight, brokers said.
At 0015 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was up 152.61 points or 0.76 percent at 20,309.63. September Nikkei futures rose 140 points to 20,320.
A broker at a medium-sized Japanese securities house said the Nikkei was ready to climb on the back of Wall Street's gains.
